Hello Fellow AirBnB Hosts and Travellers,

My husband Jonathan and I are delighted to have the opportunity to host honoured guests in our home.  I have always love being a hostess and this will enable me to enjoy this and meet some amazing new people along the way.  I hope our home brings you as much joy as it does for us.

A little background on our family.  Jonathan and I were married in May 2014 and we do not have any children.  Jonathan is from the Midlands of the UK and I grew up in French Canada (and therefore I speak fluent French) and lived in Minnesota as well.  We lived in South Carolina for several years and had the opportunity to host there, and hope to have the same wonderful experience here in Music City. Jonathan is only a recent transplant to the USA and can still be heard speaking with a lovely British accent.  Jon gets a kick out of how much us Americans fawn over his accent!  If you have no idea what he said...then he probably used a fancy English word that we don't use here, I am constantly discovering new words.

We both enjoy watching movies and use Netflix quite a bit!  Some of our most recent views include, Aquaman, and Watership Down.

 Jonathan is a professional musician and plays the bass trombone as his main instrument.  If you have ever wanted to see an enormous music library this is the place for you.  He has a small music studio lined with shelving covered with sheet music and over 900 CD's.  He is especially a Jazz lover, but has an incredible array of music available.  

I enjoy art of all types though I have not been able to invest as much in it as I like.  I also really enjoy Swing Dance and Lindy Hop.  Though I do not get to go very often, I can direct you to our local community should you wish to dance on Friday nights!Horses are another great love of mine, if I had the money and the space, I would have one of my own.

Before I forget, we don't have any children but we do have another very important member to our household: our cat Grace.  Grace is a beautiful calico that has never hurt a fly, she will be forever in your debt for a little bit of scratching and tends to be pretty quiet most of the time.  If you have cat allergies this is not the best place for you. Our guest room does have a closed door however.

In our home we hope to make your stay as comfy as your home, while offering as many hotel amenities as possible.   For the caffeine lovers of the world, a coffee pot will be available whenever you need it.  For those that are more of a tea persuasion, Jonathan can show you how to make a true British pot of tea.

Hope to have the pleasure of hosting you soon.

Sarah and Jonathan
